description:
**File**: `src/services/favicon_sync_service.cr:218-280`

**Severity**: P2 (startup latency + actor mailbox saturation)

`process_google_backfills` and `process_missing_backfills` each iterate
over the backfill array and call `FaviconActor.instance.fetch_and_save`
sequentially. Each call is a `def_call` — allocates a
`Channel(String).new(1)`, a `CallFetchAndSave` struct, JSON
serialization for the reply, then waits for the actor to handle it.

For 207 feeds with 50+ needing backfill, this is 50+ round-trips
through the FaviconActor mailbox on startup, holding the startup
fiber for many seconds.

**Fix sketch**:
1. Add `def_call backfill_many(urls : Array(String)), Array(String?)`
   to FaviconActor
2. The actor loops over the urls internally (single mailbox entry)
3. Push the whole backfill list through one call

Found during code review 2026-06-18, see
`planning/code-review-2026-06-18.md` §2.4.
title: FaviconSyncService backfill runs sequentially (N def_call round-trips on startup)
